decisions.decision: Keep source snapshots on a 1Gi RWO PVC mounted at /var/lib/knowledge-server and configure SNAPSHOT_STORAGE_DIR.
decisions.rationale: Canonical published Markdown must survive pod restart; Neo4j is only a rebuildable projection.

decisions.decision: Use local Xenova multilingual-e5-small embeddings with 384 dimensions and sub-batch document embedding.
decisions.rationale: K8s environment uses local ONNX; batches avoid peak memory growth and persistent cache avoids repeat model download.

decisions.decision: Rebuild prepares READY candidate only; activation is separate CAS operation.
decisions.rationale: Allows validation before changing live pointer and preserves rollback semantics.
